chapter.verse: Topa aw, thuman kong ngetna hong za in la, ka otna aw hong ngai in! Zuau baang lo muk pana ka thugetna hong ngai in!
Ka tan’na nangma kiang panin hong kilangsak ta in! Na mitte thuman musak ta in!
Keima lungsim hong sin in la, zan-in nangmah ka kiangah hong hawh in la, keimah hong ze-et lecin, ka sungah gitlohna na mu kei ding hi; ka kam in khial lo hi.
Mite’ gamtatna tawh kisai-in ci leng, nangma muk pan-a hong pai thu tawh mi ngongtatte’ lampi ka pelh kim hi.
Ka kalsuannate in nangma lampi-ah kip khin a, ka khe taal lo hi.
Pasian aw, hong dawng ding na hih manin nang kong sam hi; na bil hong ngat in la ka thu hong za in.
Amau’ langpangte’ kiang panin na taklam khut hong belte’ Honpa aw, na itna kip lamdang takin hong lak in.
Kei hong sutgawp migilo, keimah hong umcih ka gal kihtak huaite kiang panin mitnauta bangin hong kem in la, na kha lim-ah hong seel in.
Amaute in hehpihna lungsim nei lo uh a, a kam uh tawh amaute kiphatsak pau uh hi.
Amaute in kei hong sulzuih uh a, tu-in amaute in kei hong umcihin, keimah leilak den’ nadingin hong en uh hi.
Amaute in a balnen nuam humpinelkai tawh kibang uh a, humpinelkai khanglai sa-pang tawh kibang uh hi.

Topa aw, tho in! Amaute maiphut in la, thalpaih in! Topa aw, a deih khempeuh uh hih leitungah a nei migilote kiang panin nangma khut leh na namsau tawh kei hong honkhia in. Amau’ adingin na koihcing danpiaknate thuaksak in la, a tate un zong a cing valin thuak uh hen la, a naungekte’ adingin nusiat lai ta uh hen.
Kei ka hih leh, thumanna tawh na maitang ka en ding a, ka khanlawh ciangin, nangma mel muhna tawh ka lungkim ding hi.
